relations.subject: James Robert Ballantyne
relations.evidence: From 1832 to 1845 he was a master at the Scottish Naval and Military Academy in Edinburgh

relations.subject: James Robert Ballantyne
relations.evidence: From 1845 he was superintendent of the Sanskrit College (Benares) in Varanasi (then known as Benares). He went to England in 1861

relations.subject: James Robert Ballantyne
relations.evidence: He went to England in 1861 where he was elected librarian of the India Office.
